subject: Comp band anchor scenarios & localized benchmarking — review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Comp band anchor scenarios & localized benchmarking — draft

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Attached is the first pass of the "anchor scenarios" workbook I mentioned in People Ops sync. Key pieces are:
- Sheet A: three anchor strategies (centralized median, market-indexed anchor, and blended anchor) with offer bands calculated for L4-L7.
- Sheet B: geo deltas (US, EU, APAC) using 2026 comp data from Benchmarking Insights and our internal offer history.
- Sheet C: example offer packages for critical hires (SWE lead, PM Sr, MLE).

As requested, I preserved a conservative midpoint for cost forecasting but included a second column showing uplift to achieve top-quartile recruiting competitiveness in each market. The workbook flags roles where caching/quantization expertise should get an additional premium — those are highlighted in yellow.

Open questions for review:
1) Do we accept the blended anchor (60% global median + 40% local index) as the default for outbound offers?
2) For APAC we currently have sparse salary data; do we trust the vendor-provided deltas or should we set hard caps for now?
3) For leadership hires (L7+), do we want a separate discretionary pool rather than fitting them strictly into band ranges?

Please review the attached and add inline comments. If this looks like a go, I can produce a short playbook for recruiters with canned email language and negotiation guardrails.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp-band-anchor-scenarios.xlsx, geo-bench-summary.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comp band anchor scenarios & localized benchmarking — draft

Thanks Marissa — good work and thorough breakdown. Quick notes after skim: 

- I like the blended anchor; it hedges against overpaying in small markets while improving competitiveness in high-demand metros. Recommend we model P&L impact at 6- and 12-month hiring velocity assumptions (you can reuse the FY26 hire cadence).
- For APAC: vendor deltas are directionally useful but treat Jakarta/Manila differently from Singapore/Tokyo. Suggest we create a shallow bucket for "emerging APAC" with a +5% manual uplift to offers for critical ICs until we get better data.
- Leadership (L7+): yes, separate discretionary committee is best. It preserves flexibility and keeps band ceiling intact for standard ladders.

Two tactical asks:
1) Can you add a column in Sheet B with last-12-month offer acceptance rate by market (we can pull from ATS logs)? That will help justify uplifts.
2) Please add an example of a blended anchor rollback (how we revert to global median if the role is mission-critical but we must constrain cost).

If you can get a v2 with those items by EOD, I can brief the Head of Eng sync tomorrow.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Comp band anchor scenarios & localized benchmarking — draft

Appreciate the fast turnaround. High-level: I support piloting the blended anchor for our next hiring cohort with two guardrails: (A) a hard cap per role band rationalized to FY27 budget, and (B) a threshold acceptance delta — if acceptance rates do not improve by >4 percentage points in the pilot markets we revert.

Operational asks:
- Neha, can you confirm whether the FY27 hiring budget has slack to absorb the blended-anchored offers for the first two quarters? If not, call out which headcount types are constrained (IC vs leadership vs contractor conversions).
- Marissa, please include the acceptance rate column Laura asked for and add a short template for recruiter negotiation language. Also flag any roles that will likely require sign-on or equity adjustments outside of the band.

If we agree, I'd like to present the pilot scope (markets, roles, budget delta) to the ELT on Friday.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Updated: Comp band anchor scenarios & geo accept rate appendix

All — attached v2. Summary of what changed: 
- Added acceptance-rate column in Sheet B (last-12-months) pulled from HireWise ATS exports; note on methodology included in cell comments.
- Added an "APAC emerging" bucket with a +5% provisional uplift and a caveat to re-evaluate after Q3.
- Included a rollback example (Sheet D) that shows step-by-step: recruiter pause -> offer at global median -> discretionary review if still negative.
- Highlighted roles (SWE lead, Model Infra PM) that likely need one-time sign-on to clear counteroffers.
